note: `create_hindsight_tools` takes the memory bank when the tools are built, and the tools pass that `bank_id` to every retain, recall and reflect call; they take no run config. An agent built once at startup, as in the README's Quick Start, then stores and recalls the memories of every user in one bank, whatever `user_id` a request is configured with. The module gives the agent with the runs of two users.
